ITEM 1 | Pale golden-white chunky pieces with reddish-orange sauce clinging to them, irregular shapes about 3-4 cm, slightly glossy and moist, some browned edges, sitting on the left side of the plate | 75
ITEM 2 | Mound of pinkish-tan granular mixture under bright orange-red sauce, with visible green flecks and a red piece, crumbly and moist, roughly 5 cm across and 2 cm tall, sitting beside and partly overlapping the pale chunks | 85
ITEM 3 | Whole and halved Brussels sprouts, dark olive-green with charred, browned and slightly wilted outer leaves, glossy with oil or moisture, mostly intact with some torn leaf pieces, clustered on the right side of the plate covering about 20 percent of the plate | 95
